# Brass Leaf Cigar & Jazz Lounge

> Brass Leaf, at Hayden Peak Crossings in North Scottsdale, Arizona, is OPEN, offering exceptional cuisine, fine spirits, music and an inviting cigar patio. It is evolving into North Scottsdale's premier luxury cigar and jazz lounge, where premium cigars, refined hospitality and live jazz come together. A walk-in humidor opens soon.

## The facts

- Name: Brass Leaf Cigar & Jazz Lounge
- Address: 20469 N Hayden Rd, Scottsdale, AZ 85255, at Hayden Peak Crossings on the corner of Hayden Road and Thompson Peak Parkway
- Area: North Scottsdale, near Grayhawk and DC Ranch, just north of the Loop 101
- Phone: (623) 401-9463
- Email: info@brassleafcigars.com (general), events@brassleafcigars.com (events), michelle@brassleafcigars.com (Michelle)
- Hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 3 pm to 9 pm. Sunday, 3 pm to 8 pm. Closed Monday.
- Website: https://brassleafcigars.com/

## Open now

- A full menu from a classically trained chef, with the flavors of the Caribbean and the Southwest.
- Live acoustic jazz on certain nights.
- The Brass Leaf Live Jazz Experience: premier table reservations range from $15 to $30 per table during select live jazz performances. Food, beverages and cigars are available separately. Complimentary bar seating is available, subject to availability. Brass Leaf members enjoy exclusive reservation privileges and preferred entertainment pricing.
- Cigars are smoked on the patio only. Non-smokers are welcome.
- About 200 wines in the cellar, craft cocktails and beer.

## Coming

- Our goal is simple: to establish Brass Leaf as one of the Valley's premier destinations for cigar enthusiasts, where fine cigars, hospitality, and jazz come together. The site shows renderings of the design, room by room.
- Brass Leaf Cigar & Jazz Lounge — Where Every Draw Has Rhythm.
- The walk-in humidor opens soon. An exact date is currently not available. Visitors can leave an email address on the site to be told when it opens.
- The proposed Cigar VIP membership program is coming soon, with the top tier VIP membership including a joint cigar & wine membership.

## Membership

- The wine club has two tiers. Enthusiast is $120 for four months ($150 with setup) or $375 a year ($405 with setup). Connoisseur is $280 for four months ($310 with setup) or $780 a year ($810 with setup). There is a $30 setup fee on each plan. These numbers may change based on the new membership program.
- We are also developing a new membership program that will bring together both our cigar and wine offerings. The program is intended to provide members with additional benefits, exclusive experiences, and access to select amenities within Brass Leaf. We are currently working through the membership structure, benefits, and pricing, and will share those details once finalized. Our goal is to create a program that appeals to both cigar enthusiasts and wine connoisseurs, while offering a unique experience for those who appreciate both.
- Both tiers include two curated bottles every other month, tastings, and access to the members' lounge. The Enthusiast tier includes lounge access for one guest, and Connoisseur includes access for up to three guests.
- Every other month, one tier or the other has a wine social to pour the wines the sommelier has selected.
- Membership itself will live on the main website. Until then, visitors can leave an email address and say which program interests them.

## Common questions

- Are you open now? Yes, as a restaurant, Tuesday to Saturday from 3 pm to 9 pm and Sunday from 3 pm to 8 pm. Closed Monday.
- Where can I smoke a cigar? On the patio. Cigars are smoked on the patio only.
- When does the walk-in humidor open? Soon. An exact date is currently not available.
- I don't smoke. Is it for me? Yes, you are welcome. Cigars are smoked on the patio only.
- Do I need a reservation? Not required but recommended.
- How long does a cigar take? Most guests give one an hour and a half or two.
- Do you serve food? Yes, a full menu from a classically trained chef.
- Is there a membership? Yes. Membership will change from the old Pinard wine membership. Current members will be grandfathered.
